episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overviewEn: In a futuristic LA, mysterious Outer Ring sushi chef Jiro sets off a violent chain of events after a customer violates his one rule: no soy sauce.

episodes.name: Meat Is Murder
episodes.overviewEn: Jiro is tasked with making a special delivery to an LA food festival, but must survive a gauntlet of bounty hunter food trucks along the way.

episodes.name: The Ortolan
episodes.overviewEn: Jiro takes on a new apprentice and learns to cook a controversial new dish and finds himself in the crosshairs of a meticulous assassin.

episodes.name: Secret Sauce
episodes.overviewEn: Bob and Rose's rivalry explodes into a damaging war. Cynda targets Jiro in her investigation and revisits her tragic family history in the process.

episodes.name: Pressure Cooker
episodes.overviewEn: An injured Jiro is relentlessly pursued by Bob's goons. Left with no choice, Jiro is forced to prepare a special omakase for Bob's right-hand man.

episodes.name: Tokyo Story
episodes.overviewEn: Explore Jiro's origins in Tokyo, where he is torn between two conflicting worlds.

episodes.name: Cage Free
episodes.overviewEn: An unexpected ally visits Jiro in Butcher's Block Penitentiary and helps him mount an escape attempt.

episodes.name: Your Guests Have Arrived
episodes.overviewEn: Jiro is forced to cook a meal using a taboo ingredient. Meanwhile, Ichigo is summoned to LA, and Cynda tries to figure out Jiro's endgame.

episodes.name: Our Specials This Evening
episodes.overviewEn: Jiro and his newfound allies formulate a plan to take down Rose, and Jiro confronts his brother one final time.

episodes.name: Gochisousama
episodes.overviewEn: Jiro and Ichigo confront each other and the childhood trauma that led them on this path of vengeance.
